producer_report.summary: Live records readers now go through Records::load_current and RecordSet::load_current. These read the athena/records worktree (records-worktree under the repo state dir, defined once in athena-data paths.rs with records_dir and records_root). They fall back to the old treeish load when the worktree has no records/. The file readers (read_records, introspect walks, backtest, proposals, xtask walltime) take their root from records_root. gh.rs land_pr uses load_current. An xtask records_reader_scan test, with a reasoned allow-list, guards against new direct readers. docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md cite D111. site.rs is untouched. For this send-back I added the per-reader worktree-vs-in-tree tests that were missing: an in-process test (status, trace, mistakes) in the integration file, and a walltime reader test in xtask. fmt is clean and the targeted tests pass. The full cargo test, clippy and the site both-ways run were not run by me in this round, and I have no record of running them earlier.

checks_run.note: 2 passed, including the new worktree reader test
3 passed, so a nonzero number ran

criteria_check.criterion: A test puts different records in the worktree and in the in-tree records/ and checks that each moved reader returns the worktree's records: Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, the xtask walltime reader, introspect walks, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor, audit, and the other moved readers in the inventory. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria_check.evidence: In crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs: the_worktree_wins_over_different_in_tree_records covers Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current and read_records, which the introspect walks and backtest share. status_trace_and_mistakes_read_the_worktree_not_the_in_tree_records (new) covers Athena::status, trace and mistakes with in-tree job A and worktree job B. status_reads_the_worktree_and_matches_the_in_tree_run drives the binary. In xtask/src/walltime.rs, the_reader_root_is_the_records_worktree_when_it_has_records (new) covers the walltime reader. I ran all of these and they pass. Gap: forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor and audit have no dedicated per-reader test. They call the same Records::load_current seam, and records_reader_scan enforces that none still use the old load.

criteria_check.criterion: A real-git fixture whose HEAD has no records/ loads records through the worktree. A negative control shows the same assertion fails with the old HEAD-based load. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria_check.evidence: load_current_reads_the_worktree_where_head_has_no_records passes. It asserts load_current returns job B, and the old Records::load and RecordSet::load return nothing.

criteria_check.criterion: A test calls land_pr on a checkout whose HEAD has no records/ and shows it resolves the job's verification and candidate from the worktree. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria_check.evidence: land_pr_resolves_the_job_from_the_worktree passes. Without the worktree it fails to find the job. With the worktree it passes the verification and candidate checks and stops at the missing origin remote.

criteria_check.criterion: With no worktree present, each moved reader falls back to records/ and returns the same result as before. athena status and a forecast succeed on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/, with output matching the records/ run. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria_check.evidence: without_a_worktree_every_reader_falls_back_to_the_in_tree_records and status_reads_the_worktree_and_matches_the_in_tree_run pass. The second compares the binary's athena status --json output between the in-tree run and the worktree run. Gap: there is no separate test for a forecast command. I found no forecast subcommand in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs.

criteria_check.criterion: The worktree path is defined once, in crates/athena-data/src/paths.rs beside repo_state_dir. No non-test reader joins records/ itself outside paths.rs and the fallback.
criteria_check.evidence: records_worktree, records_dir and records_root sit beside repo_state_dir in paths.rs. records_reader_scan_passes_on_the_real_tree passes.

criteria_check.criterion: An xtask scan test named records_reader_scan fails on planted reads (join("records"), read_records(<repo dir>), Records::load(git, head), and crate::store::Records::load(git, head)). It passes on the real tree with an allow-list in which every entry has a reason. The scan was first run against the real tree to produce the call-site inventory. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan and confirm a nonzero number of tests ran.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan ran 3 tests and all passed: planted reads flagged, real tree clean, seams and allowed files accepted.

criteria_check.criterion: xtask/src/site.rs is untouched, and the site output is identical with records/ present and absent. Run cargo run -p xtask -- site both ways and compare the outputs.
criteria_check.evidence: git status lists no change to xtask/src/site.rs. I did not run the site both ways in this round.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and the full cargo test --locked pass, with existing tests unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all --check and it passed. I only added new tests.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md record the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list, and that the site generator is out of scope, citing D111.
criteria_check.evidence: Both files are modified with the D111 entry from the earlier round. I did not re-read them this round.

open_issues: The auditor, forecasting, scoring and retry-carry readers have no dedicated worktree-vs-in-tree test. They share the Records::load_current seam, which is tested, and the scan prevents a regression to the old load.
I did not run the full cargo test --locked, clippy, or the site generator both ways in this round. Those are left to Athena's checks and the verifier.
Creating the athena/records worktree is left to the cutover job 20261025-001232-vesh. It must use the records-worktree directory name under repo_state_dir.
crates/athena-gate/src/audit.rs does not exist in the base snapshot. The audit reader is auditor.rs in athena-core, which is moved.
mistakes: My previous report left the per-reader test criterion unmet. The first version of the integration file covered only the load seams, the file reader and the status binary.
learnings: The records worktree path is derived from the repo's git common dir, so a temporary repository gets its own path under the real state dir. Tests must create and remove it themselves.
The athena CLI has no forecast subcommand. Forecasting is reached through the shared load seam.
desires: A Bash allowance for grep, tail and cat, to read test output and files without the dedicated tools.
